name: HIP 64892

planets.name: B
planets.note: Brown dwarf companion (M9γ±1, ~29-37 MJup) at 1.2705±0.0023" (159±12 AU projected); Teff ~2600 K; extreme mass ratio q~0.01. No resolved disk detected; mid/far-IR photometry used only to bound the mass of any undetected debris disk.

paper.title: Discovery of a brown dwarf companion to the star HIP 64892

notes: B9.5V member of the Lower Centaurus Crux subgroup of Sco-Cen, age ~16 Myr. Companion HIP 64892 B was discovered with VLT/SPHERE during the SHINE survey and recovered in archival 2011 VLT/NACO L' sparse-aperture-masking data (Cheetham+2018). No resolved circumstellar disk is detected; the paper models upper limits on an undetected debris disk and explores in-situ disk-instability formation for the companion, but categorizes this as a planet/brown-dwarf-only system.
